mapper.select: SELECT l.lock_id as lockId, l.ip_address as ipAddress, l.sn_code as snCode, l.port_number as portNumber, CASE WHEN l.door_channel='1' AND l.observed_at >= DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','+08:00'), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) THEN l.switch_status ELSE NULL END as switchStatus, l.observed_at as observedAt, l.JSH as classroomNumber, l.remarks, l.classroom_id as classroomId, l.door_channel as doorChannel, c.SKDD as classroomName, c.XQMC as campusName, c.JZWMC as buildingName, c.floor FROM sys_lock_info l LEFT JOIN sys_classroom c ON l.classroom_id = c.id WHERE l.lock_id = #{lockId}

SELECT l.lock_id as lockId, l.ip_address as ipAddress, l.sn_code as snCode, l.port_number as portNumber, CASE WHEN l.door_channel='1' AND l.observed_at >= DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','+08:00'), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) THEN l.switch_status ELSE NULL END as switchStatus, l.observed_at as observedAt, l.JSH as classroomNumber, l.remarks, l.classroom_id as classroomId, l.door_channel as doorChannel, c.SKDD as classroomName, c.XQMC as campusName, c.JZWMC as buildingName, c.floor FROM sys_lock_info l LEFT JOIN sys_classroom c ON l.classroom_id = c.id WHERE BINARY c.board_sn = BINARY #{boardSn}

SELECT l.lock_id as lockId, l.ip_address as ipAddress, l.sn_code as snCode, l.port_number as portNumber, CASE WHEN l.door_channel='1' AND l.observed_at >= DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','+08:00'), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) THEN l.switch_status ELSE NULL END as switchStatus, l.observed_at as observedAt, l.JSH as classroomNumber, l.remarks, l.classroom_id as classroomId, l.door_channel as doorChannel, c.SKDD as classroomName, c.XQMC as campusName, c.JZWMC as buildingName, c.floor, c.board_sn as boardSn FROM sys_lock_info l LEFT JOIN sys_classroom c ON l.classroom_id = c.id

SELECT l.lock_id as lockId, l.ip_address as ipAddress, l.sn_code as snCode, l.port_number as portNumber, CASE WHEN l.door_channel='1' AND l.observed_at >= DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(),'+00:00','+08:00'), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) THEN l.switch_status ELSE NULL END as switchStatus, l.observed_at as observedAt, l.JSH as classroomNumber, l.remarks, l.classroom_id as classroomId, l.door_channel as doorChannel, c.SKDD as classroomName, c.XQMC as campusName, c.JZWMC as buildingName, c.floor FROM sys_lock_info l LEFT JOIN sys_classroom c ON l.classroom_id = c.id WHERE l.JSH = #{classroomNumber}
